summary: Windows-first local RAG desktop app: WPF/WebView2 shell, in-process ASP.NET Minimal API backend, React/Vite web UI, SQLite plus sqlite-vec local storage, Ollama integration, OCR and Office ingestion support, and Inno Setup packaging.
active_objective: Final cross-cutting maintenance and readiness pass completed: repository setup, gate, docs/assets, CI, packaging, and quality state were verified; one small gate packaging bug was fixed.
assumptions: Existing uncommitted source and documentation changes predate this final pass and were preserved.
Generated outputs under bin, obj, dist, node_modules, and artifacts are build artifacts, not source state.

OCR runtime preparation and live Ollama model workflows are optional feature paths; the final bootstrap run intentionally skipped OCR installation and Ollama probing to avoid heavy optional setup work.
Interactive desktop launch and installer lifecycle operations require user-facing Windows UI changes, so they were not executed during this non-invasive readiness pass.

decisions.decision: Treat Windows plus PowerShell 7 as the primary development and release environment.
decisions.impact: Repository commands, path checks, installer verification, and release tasks are evaluated against Windows tooling first.

decisions.decision: Use npm as the frontend package manager because src/OnlyRag.Web/package-lock.json is present and package.json scripts are npm-based.
decisions.impact: Do not introduce pnpm, yarn, or alternate frontend package manager conventions.

decisions.decision: Do not promote installer artifacts as release artifacts until a trusted code-signing certificate, signtool, Inno Setup, and signed lifecycle verification are available.
decisions.impact: Packaging can be verified separately from release; signed release tasks remain blocked.

decisions.decision: Limit this pass to three behavior-preserving C# refactors in active persistence, document import, API, and WPF shutdown paths.
decisions.impact: Shared SQL IN parameter creation, document size formatting, and WPF JSON read options are consolidated without moving public endpoints, changing SQLite schema, changing settings keys, or touching pre-existing React UI edits.

decisions.decision: Limit this pass to three directly inferable risks: local API token egress guard in the web client, bounded/sanitized Ollama external error bodies, and concurrent stdout/stderr reads for local setup processes.
decisions.impact: No package versions or lockfiles changed; verification used existing npm, NuGet, lint, format, typecheck, build, and xUnit gates.

decisions.decision: Use an Inno Setup Pascal Script wrapper for prerequisite dialog lines instead of pixel-specific page fixes.
decisions.impact: Unsupported-Windows and missing-WebView2 dialogs share one wrapping behavior, preserving the existing installer technology while reducing clipping risk for long product names, paths, URLs, and localized wording.

decisions.decision: Preserve the existing OnlyRag Windows-first identity and extend the generated asset inventory instead of introducing a rebrand.
decisions.impact: The source app icon, favicon/PWA assets, GitHub README logo, social card images, and Inno Setup wizard artwork remain generated by scripts\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1 from the existing editable SVG and WPF drawing pipeline.

decisions.decision: Close this pass as verification and small localized maintenance only; do not reopen broad refactors, redesign, packaging changes, or security hardening initiatives.
decisions.impact: Only scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 was changed in this pass; remaining release work stays limited to concrete external verification items.

next_tasks: Provision a trusted Windows code-signing certificate outside Git, then run scripts\Sign-Release.ps1 with the certificate password supplied through ONLYRAG_CERT_PASSWORD or a secure prompt.
Run scripts\Test-InstallerRelease.ps1 -InstallerPath .\artifacts\installer\OnlyRag-Setup-0.1.0-win-x64.exe -RequireSigned -RunInstallLifecycle on a clean Windows verification machine after signing.
Run pwsh .\scripts\Bootstrap-Prerequisites.ps1 without -SkipOcr on a machine intended to use OCR, then audit scripts\ocr\requirements.txt with pip-audit or safety when one is available.
Run the interactive desktop app and browser UI against real imported documents, active jobs, and translation records before public release sign-off.

blockers.reason: No code-signing certificate/private key is present under certificates\app; the generated installer is unsigned. Inno Setup 6.7.1 and Windows SDK signtool.exe are available locally.
Install, launch, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, SmartScreen, and signed enforcement checks were intentionally not run on this development machine.

risks.description: The repository remains on main with uncommitted source, script, documentation, and PROJECT_STATUS.json changes; review and commit intentionally before release work.
The installer built by the gate is valid as an unsigned package artifact only; it is not a signed release candidate.
Installer lifecycle and SmartScreen behavior were not executed; only non-invasive installer evidence was generated.
Final bootstrap verification used -SkipOcr; OCR runtime setup remains a concrete optional-feature verification item for OCR release support.
The WPF desktop app and populated live UI workflows were not launched during this pass to avoid invasive interactive state changes.
No pip-audit or safety command was available locally, so Python OCR package vulnerability status was not verified.

runtime: Self-contained .NET 10 runtime components in packaged app
Ollama for chat, embeddings, and translation model features
Optional LibreOffice for legacy Office conversion and PDF export
Optional Python 3.10+ PaddleOCR runtime for OCR
development: ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, and Vite from src\OnlyRag.Web
Windows SDK signtool.exe for signed release candidates
external_services: Ollama endpoint, local or explicitly trusted non-loopback
RFC 3161 timestamp server for release signing

configuration_sources: Persistent UI/backend settings are stored in SQLite settings rows: Ollama, performance, OCR, OCR processing, ingestion, and Office conversion.

Application defaults live in code: AppStoragePaths, OllamaEndpointOptions, OcrSettings, OcrPipelineOptions, IngestionSettingsStore, OfficeConversionSettingsStore, PerformanceSettingsService, and backend options.
Environment variables are optional overrides for development/runtime helpers: ONLYRAG_WEB_DEV_SERVER, ONLYRAG_LIBREOFFICE_PATH, ONLYRAG_OCR_PYTHON, ONLYRAG_OCR_BRIDGE, and ONLYRAG_CERT_PASSWORD.
CLI/script arguments are used by PowerShell bootstrap, gate, build, installer, signing, and verification scripts.
Frontend package manifest and web manifest are package.json and src\OnlyRag.Web\public\site.webmanifest; installer manifest is packaging\OnlyRag.iss.
last_completed_work: Fixed scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -IncludeInstaller argument passing, verified bootstrap, full gate with installer packaging, non-invasive installer evidence, docs/assets/manifest links, generated-output hygiene, and high-confidence secret scan.
handoff_notes: Final readiness pass is complete. Main gates passed and an unsigned installer was generated at artifacts\installer\OnlyRag-Setup-0.1.0-win-x64.exe. Do not call this a signed production release until certificate provisioning, signing, clean-machine installer lifecycle verification, and interactive runtime checks are completed.
